title: Victim of fatal Clapham shooting named
description: A 22-year-old man who attended hospital with a gunshot wound has been arrested, the Met Police says.
content:
A man who was shot dead in south-west London has been named by police as Auguste-Marie Bile-aka Amoa.
Officers and paramedics were called to Willington Road, Clapham, just before 22:00 BST on Monday following reports of gunshots near The Landor pub.
